content.content:
We need to create a 7-day travel plan, departing from Wichita to Colorado, visiting 3 cities. Dates March 7-13 2022 (7 days). Budget $5900.

We need to output day plans using submit_day_plan function for each day (7 calls). Must include city, transportation, meals, attractions, accommodation.

We need to decide which three Colorado cities: maybe Denver, Colorado Springs, Boulder. Starting from Wichita. Day 1 travel from Wichita to Denver. Day 2 Denver. Day 3 Denver to Colorado Springs. Day 4 Colorado Springs. Day 5 Colorado Springs to Boulder. Day 6 Boulder. Day7 Boulder back to Wichita.

Include transportation details (maybe flight, rental car). Provide meals and attractions.

We don't need to ask follow-up.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Ensure fields: day, current_city (the city for the day; if traveling between two, "from A to B"? The spec: city for this day. If plan is to travel between two cities, indicate as "from A to B". There is also separate transportation field for details.

Thus for travel days, current_city could be "from Wichita to Denver". And transportation details.

Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner strings. Attractions: list with semicolons. If none, maybe "-".

Accommodation: name of hotel.

We'll do:

Day 1 March 7: Travel from Wichita to Denver (flight). Breakfast maybe at home? Could be "Hotel in Wichita"? Use dash? We'll include breakfast at airport.

Day 2 March 8: Denver. Attractions: "Denver Botanic Gardens, Denver; Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Denver; Union Station, Denver". Meals.

Day 3 March 9: Travel Denver to Colorado Springs (rental car). Attractions maybe "Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs" after arrival.

Day 4 March 10: Colorado Springs. Attractions: "Pikes Peak, Colorado Springs; U.S. Air Force Academy, Colorado Springs".

Day 5 March 11: Travel Colorado Springs to Boulder (rental car). Attractions: "Pearl Street Mall, Boulder".

Day 6 March 12: Boulder. Attractions: "Chautauqua Park, Boulder; Boulder Museum of Contemporary Art, Boulder".

Day 7 March 13: Travel Boulder to Wichita (flight from Denver? Might need to drive back to Denver then flight). Simpler: drive to Denver and flight back. So "from Boulder to Wichita". Transportation: "Rental car to Denver, then flight". Accommodation dash.

Now we must call submit_day_plan for each day. Ensure correct fields.

We'll assume reasonable budget.

Now produce calls.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
